answer: Escrow deposits plus a referral graph stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts 200 units for 20 epochs and names a sponsor. The graph exposes newcomers sharing one sponsor as a reef-like star cluster. An upheld dispute slashes the deposit and fines the sponsor equally. Faking 100 identities costs 40,000 units, far above one vote's reward. An honest agent crosses this bridge once, pays once, and keeps undiluted rewards in the meadow of work.
